Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! West Indies players are out there in the middle. Max O'Dowd and Vikramjit Singh are the openers for Netherlands. Jayden Seales to start with the ball for West Indies. He is on debut. Let's see how he goes about his business. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Now then, Netherlands have not been at their best with the bat and West Indies have done exceedingly well with the ball. West Indies might be the favourites here to win, but we can not count Netherlands out of this one. They are truly capable of chasing this one down. Stay tuned for the second essay.

It was a disappointing bowling show from the Dutch. In the previous two games, it was their bowling that caused some kind of trouble, but they have failed to replicate the same here. They started on the right foot by grabbing the wicket of Shai Hope but post that they were not as disciplined. They gave away 24 runs in extras which included 16 wides and 4 no balls. In the middle phase, Aryan Dutt was the bowler who kept things quiet. There were a few LBW calls that did not go their way, but that was it. However, they did well to pull things back in the last 10 overs of the game. They grabbed 4 wickets and gave away 67 runs. Things could have gone a lot worse for the home side, but they still face a daunting task ahead of them. Other than, Pieter Seelaar, all the other bowlers grabbed a wicket each, but Aryan Dutt was definitely the pick of the bowlers.

After electing to bat first,  West Indies decided to make a change in their batting order. Kyle Mayers was asked to open alongside Shai Hope. This change certainly did wonders for the visitors. Shai Hope and Kyle Mayers put on 58 runs together before losing Hope in the 12th over. Post that, Shamarh Brooks walked in and he along with Kyle Mayers stitched a partnership of 184 runs and guided West Indies close to a score of 250. However, Kyle Mayers notched his maiden century and perished soon after that. Shamarh Brooks went on till the end and he too scored a sublime ton and made sure to get West Indies across the 300-run mark. There were a few cameos in the middle, and that eventually helped West Indies to set a target of 309. But the first innings certainly belonged only to two people, Kyle Mayers and Shamarh Brooks. It's up to the bowlers now!

For the first time in the series, West Indies have batted first and have put on a stupendous show. Although they would feel they fell short of around 20 runs after the start they got. Nevertheless, they have still managed to put a healthy total on the board. It's been a good fightback from Netherlands. West Indies were well on course to make over 320 runs but the hosts have done well to pull things back towards the end and have restricted them to a score of under 310. The visitors will be the happier side going into the break.

Dot ball to end the innings and a brilliant last over by Kingma! Just 6 runs from it. Nails a yorker on middle. Bonner only manages to dig it out back to the bowler. West Indies finish with 308/5 after 50 overs!
A short ball on off. Brooks pulls it to deep square leg for a single.

Century for Shamarh Brooks! It has been a fantastic knock from the stylish right-hander and now two balls to go, can he do some damage? A fuller delivery on middle. Brooks flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Dot ball! A slower bumper, outside off. It never arrives and Brooks is early on his slap. Only manages to get the bottom of his blade.
A very full delivery on off. Brooks hits it straight down the ground and comes back for the second run.
A low full toss on the pads. Bonner flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Bonner works it to wide long on for a single. Brooks is on 96. Will he get his hundred in the final over?
WIDE! Goes short on off. Bonner tries to pull it but misses. It is too high and the umpire calls it wide.
A full delivery, on off. Bonner looks to drive it away but gets the inside edge towards the leg side.
FOUR! This is a good short ball on off. Bonner looks to pull but gets hit on the helmet.The ball defelcts off his helmet and goes towards the third man fence for a boundary. Four Leg byes given.
WIDE! This is full and outside off. Bonner leaves it alone.
Short and wide, outside off. Bonner cuts it to deep point for a couple.
On a length, outside off. Brooks drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
A fuller ball, on off. Bonner drives it staright but it hits the stumps at the bowler's end. So just a single in the end.
A fuller delivery this time, around middle and leg. Nkrumah Bonner flicks though mid-wicket for a single.
Darting it on the pads, on a length. Nkrumah Bonner works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Another length delivery, around middle. Shamarh Brooks pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, around middle and leg. Nkrumah Bonner tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Shorter ball, around middle. Bonner swivels and pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. Lovely shot!
Fuller, around middle and leg. Shamarh Brooks pulls it towards long on for a single.
On a length, on off. Bonner blocks it off the front foot.
This is full and outside off. Bonner drives it to deep extra-cover for a couple.
On a length, on middle. Bonner works it to deep backward square leg and takes two. However, it is signalled as short run and it will be just a single.
Short and wide outside off. Shamarh Brooks cuts it to deep backward point for a single.
On a length, on middle. This is worked towards deep mid-wicket for just a single this time. Boundaries are not coming here for Windies!
A full delivery on the pads. Nkrumah Bonner flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Nkrumah Bonner comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another wicket and Netherlands are fighting their way back into this game. Brilliant over this and finally gets the reward with a wicket off the final ball. A slower short ball on off. Akeal Hosein pulls it but fails to get enough power on that shot. It goes in the air and towards deep mid-wicket. Musa Ahmad at the deep settles under it and takes a good catch. Can Netherlands restrict West Indies under 300?
Commentary.Howout: c Musa Ahmad b Vivian Kingma

Commentary.Commentary: Now it is full on leg. Brooks flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Well bowled! A slower short ball angling into off and middle. Brooks is early on the pull shot and misses it.
Lands on a length, on off. Akeal Hosein makes room and slaps it to long off for a single.
Goes full on middle. Brooks flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Another wide, this time for height! Kingma bangs it short on middle. Brooks ducks under it.
Drifting on the pads. Akeal Hosein flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
WIDE! Kingma starts the new spell with a wide. Sprays this down the leg side. Hosein looks to clip it but misses.
Vivian Kingma is back into the attack.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Akeal Hosein tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Length ball from 'round the wicket, around middle. Akeal Hosein defends it back to the bowler.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! A successful review for Netherlands this time! They are pulling things back towards the end. Logan van Beek grabs his first wicket and West Indies have lost their fourth. A shorter ball, around middle and off. Brandon King looks to pull this but he misses. Scott Edwards grabs the ball and appeals. The umpire says no but the keeper is convinced he heard something and Pieter Seelaar opts for a review. UltraEdge does show a spike as the ball passes through the bat. The decision needs to be reversed and Brandon King has to walk back.
Commentary.Howout: c Scott Edwards b Logan van Beek

Commentary.Commentary: Akeal Hosein is the next man in.
Wide! Wide outside off, fuller ball. Brandon King leaves it alone. Wide called!
Another fuller ball, wide of off. Brandon King steps down the track and looks to slice this away again but he misses.
FOUR! Top shot! Full delivery, width on offer. Brandon King slices it past point for a boundary.
On a length, outside off. Brandon King looks to cut this away but the ball goes off the under edge back onto the deck.
Logan van Beek is back on. Seven overs for 38 runs so far.
Full again, quicker this time, around middle and leg. Shamarh Brooks tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Very full, tosses it up, around off. Brandon King drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Pitches it up again, around middle, slower again. Shamarh Brooks clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, loopy one around middle. Brandon King knocks it towards long on for a single.
Tad shorter, quicker, around middle and leg. Brandon King tucks it towards square leg. Not in the gap though.
Fuller ball, tosses it up, around middle. Brandon King pushes it back to the bowler.
Another slower ball, on the pads. Brandon King leans forward and flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Pitches it up, around middle. Shamarh Brooks eases it to long on for a single.
A slower ball, around middle, fuller in length. Brandon King drives it with the inner half of his bat towards mid-wicket for a single.
A low full toss, around middle and leg. Shamarh Brooks flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another good-length delivery, around middle and off. Shamarh Brooks taps it towards the short fine leg region. No run taken there!
A length ball, around off. Brandon King dabs it with soft hands towards point for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle. Brandon King pushes it down to long off for a single.
Brandon King is the next man in.

OUT! LBW! Much deserving wicket for Aryan Dutt! He has now got Nicholas Pooran in all three games! Wickets in quick succession for Netherlands as Nicholas Pooran departs for a timid score. A shorter ball, this one comes in with the angle, around middle and leg. Nicholas Pooran hangs back and tries to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his pad. A huge appeal for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger. Nicholas Pooran walks back! Aryan Dutt jumps in delight!
Tad shorter, around middle and leg. Shamarh Brooks flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller again, outside off. Nicholas Pooran drives it through cover for a single. That brings up the 250 for West Indies!
FOUR! Perfect execution! Loopy ball, around middle. Nicholas Pooran gets down on his knee and reverse-sweeps this past point for a boundary.
Tosses it up, very full, around middle. Nicholas Pooran digs it back to the bowler.
Aryan Dutt comes onto bowl his last over.
Back of a length, around middle. Nicholas Pooran miscues his pull shot towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full in length, around off. Nicholas Pooran leans forward and drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Another pitched up delivery, around middle. Shamarh Brooks knocks it down to long on for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Nicholas Pooran drives it uppishly away from extra cover for a single. He gets off the mark.
Nicholas Pooran walks in at number 4.

OUT! TAKEN! A masterclass innings from Kyle Mayers has come to an end! Netherlands have finally managed to break this partnership. Ryan Klein grabs his first wicket and West Indies lose their second. Ryan Klein drops it short now, around middle. Kyle Mayers pulls this one but the ball goes straight to the fielder at deep square leg. Bas de Leede there takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Bas de Leede b Ryan Klein

Commentary.Commentary: Slower ball, length delivery, around off. Shamarh Brooks knocks it down to long off for a single.
Time for Powerplay 3! Now, 5 fielders will be allowed to be placed outside the inner circle.

SIX! That is over the fence and Mayers has just enjoyed short stuff from Dutch bowlers today! Kingma goes short on off. His pace is not the one to hurry the batter and Mayers who is ready for that short ball, pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
A slower length ball again, outside off. Mayers looks to slap it away but misses. Good delivery!
Serves it on a length, on middle. Brooks clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, on the pads. Brooks clips it straight to the short fine leg fielder.
A slower length delivery, on off. Mayers looks to slog-sweep but miscues it and the ball goes towards long on. Single taken.
A fuller delivery on middle. Brooks flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Vivian Kingma (6-0-45-0) comes back into the attack.
FOUR! Poor delivery to end the over and 15 runs from it! Shorter on pads. Mayers gets down and sweeps it again, this time finer and towards the fine leg fence.
SIX! If it's in the arc, it's out of the park! A full toss on middle. Mayers gets low and slog-sweeps it over deep square leg for a maximum.
A low full toss on the pads. Mayers flicks it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket. It falls short of the fielder in the deep and the batters run couple.
On the shorter side, on middle. Brooks punches it to long on for a single.
Spears this on middle. Mayers flicks it to long on for a single.
Quicker and around off. Brooks guides it towards third man for a single.
A fuller delivery on leg. Mayers looks to flick it but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
A slightly shorte one on middle. Mayers punches it back to the bowler.
Quicker and flatter on off. Brooks drives it to long on for a single.

There it is! It's a Mayers masterclass, his first ODI century and he is delighted as his teammates and the crowd stands up and applauds him. A flatter delivery on middle. Mayers looks to works it towards the leg side. He does it early and gets the leading edge towards covers for a single.
A flatter one on off. Mayers blocks it out.
Tossed up on off. Mayers drives it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, around off. Brooks guides it towards backward point.
SIX! Logan van Beek tries the short ball again and gets punished! On middle and at a comfortable height for Brooks. He stands tall and pulls it over deep backward square leg for a biggie.
WIDE! Bangs it short on off. It is too high and Brooks leaves it alone. The umpire calls it wide for height.
Goes fuller on middle. Mayers pushes it to long on for a single. He moves onto 99 and the partnership between these two is now 150!
Short ball again, pacy one this time. Mayers looks to pull but gets the top edge. The ball falls in the vacant region near deep backward square leg and two runs are taken.
Logan van Beek bowls a slower bouncer around leg. Mayers pulls it fine right of the keeper. Scott Edwards runs behind it and the batters run two before he cuts it off.
A fuller delivery, on middle. Mayers works it to mid-wicket.
Another single to end the over! Dutt fires this one on middle. Mayers drives it comfortably to long on and retains the strike with a single. A maximum away from his century now!
Bowls fuller again, on off. Brooks works it to long on for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Mayers drives it to covers for a single.
Pushed quicker angling into middle and leg from 'round the wicket. Mayers looks to punch it away but gets the inside edge towards square leg.
Slower in the air, on off. Brooks pushes it to long off for a single. 200 up for West Indies!
A quicker delivery on off. Brooks defends it towards point.
Aryan Dutt is back on.
Fuller ball, around middle. Shamarh Brooks knocks it down to long on for a single.
Another shortish ball, around off. Shamarh Brooks dabs it off the back foot towards the fielder at short third man. No run there!
Back of a length, around off. Shamarh Brooks taps it down towards cover-point.
Wide! Too short on this occasion, around off. Shamarh Brooks leaves it alone. Wide called for height this time!
Another off pace delivery, a low full toss, on the pads. Kyle Mayers flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Slower, shorter, down the leg side. Kyle Mayers looks to pull this but he misses. Wide called!
Another length delivery, around middle and off. Kyle Mayers dabs it with soft hands towards point.
A length ball, angling in on the pads. Shamarh Brooks glances it towards deep square leg for a single.
Logan van Beek is back on. Five overs for 21 runs so far along with one maiden.
SIX! BOOM! What a shot this from Kyle Mayers! An overpitched delivery, outside off. Kyle Mayers goes inside-out over extra cover for a biggie. He moves on to 91 with that!
Wide! Another one down leg. Kyle Mayers once again misses his pull shot and a wide is given!
Wide! Down the leg side, on a length from 'round the wicket. Kyle Mayers looks to pull this away but he misses. Wide called!
Darting it on the thigh pads, on a good length. Shamarh Brooks works it away towards deep square leg. Single taken!
Shorter ball, outside off. Shamarh Brooks miscues his cut shot back to the bowler.
Another length ball, darting it on the pads. Shamarh Brooks tucks it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Pulled away! Top shot! Back of a length, around off. Shamarh Brooks smashes it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Shamarh Brooks makes room and taps it towards cover.
Another quicker one, flatter, and shorter around middle and off. Kyle Mayers pushes it off the back foot towards the off side.
Quicker, around middle. Kyle Mayers hangs and defends it out.

DRINKS! West Indies are going along nicely here and are well set for a big score. The move to send Mayers at the top of the order has turned out to be a fruitful one and with plenty of big-hitters to follow, Windies will be looking at something more than 320 at least. Netherlands, need to take wickets and take them quickly as the match can go well out of their hands, if the West Indies batters explode in the last 10-15 overs.
SIX! KABOOM! A tossed up ball, full, around middle. Kyle Mayers dances down the track and heaves it over cow corner for a biggie.
Fuller ball, around middle and off. Shamarh Brooks knocks it down to long off for a single.

Put down! A tossed up ball, around off. Shamarh Brooks drives it firmly towards Max O'Dowd at mid off. He gets low to his left, and gets his hands to the ball but puts it down in the end. Netherlands cannot afford to drop catches!
Shorter ball, around middle. Shamarh Brooks blocks it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Shamarh Brooks cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Shamarh Brooks drives it towards cover.
Shorter ball, outside off. Shamarh Brooks gets on his toes and pushes it towards cover once again.
Outside off, on a length. Shamarh Brooks taps it towards cover off the back foot.
On a length, angling in around the thigh pads. Kyle Mayers tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Swing and a miss! Fuller ball, outside off. Kyle Mayers looks to go over cover but he misses it completely.
Bas de Leede is back on. Three overs for 19 but he has taken the only wicket that has gone down so far.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Kyle Mayers pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. He retains the strike!
Shorter ball, spinning away around off. Shamarh Brooks pushes it off the back foot through cover for a single.
A stifled appeal for LBW, but not given! An arm ball, quicker, down the leg side. Shamarh Brooks looks to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his pads. That was sliding down leg.
Shorter ball, darting it on the pads. Kyle Mayers flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Kyle Mayers leans and blocks it out.
Fuller ball, outside off. Shamarh Brooks cuts it past point for a single.

In the air...but safe! Klein goes short on middle. Mayers pulls but gets a top edge this time. The ball goes high in the air and falls in the vacant deep square leg region. Two runs taken by the batters.
It if full and angling into middle and leg. Brooks looks to flick it but gets the inside edge of his bat onto his pads. The ball rolls towards right of square leg and a single is taken.
On a length, on off. Brooks blocks it off the front foot.
A full delivery on off. Mayers drives it to long off for a single.
On a length, around off. Brooks steers it towards deep backward point for a single.
A fuller delivery, on off. Mayers drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Quicker and around off. Brooks looks to cut it but is cramped for room and mistimes it.
Flatter delivery on off. Brooks pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller and around off. Brooks defends it towards point.
FOUR! Nicely played, brilliant precision! This is full on middle. Brooks gets low and sweeps it towards deep backward square leg for a boundary.
100 runs partnership comes up! This is fuller on middle. Mayers works it to long on for a single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Mayers defends it towards the leg side.

Lovely delivery to end the over! This is pitched on a good length and around off. Brooks looks to defend it off the front foot. However, the ball seams away a bit and beats the outside edge of Brook's blade.
Back of a length, around off. Mayers defends it with soft hands towards the off side and takes a single.
Drifting on the pads and full again. Brooks flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes full on off. Mayers drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
On a length, around off. Brooks opens the face of his blade and steers it towards third man for a single.
Lands on a length, around off. Brooks looks to cut it but misses.
Ryan Klein comes back to bowl.
Single this time and it will be fifty for Brooks! Nicely paced innings this and he is looking good for many more. Fuller on off. Brooks drive it to long off for a single.
Slower in the air again, on off. Brooks drives it straight to mid off.
Tossed up, on off. Brooks blocks it off the front foot.
A full delivery, outside off. Brooks drives it to sweeper cover for a couple.
Darted on middle. Brooks works it towards mid-wicket.
A fuller delivery on middle. Brooks blocks it off the front foot.
Pieter Seelaar brings himself back on.
Back of a length, around off. Mayers looks to cut but mistimes it. 19 runs from the over!
SIX! Short ball again and punished again! Kingma bangs it short, not much pace and it sits up at a nice height for Mayers. He pulls it firmly over deep square leg for a maximum.
A fuller delivery on middle. Mayers works it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Slammed down the ground! Full on middle. Mayers hits it hard straight down the ground for a boundary.

NO BALL and SIX! This is poor from Kingma! He has overstepped again and has bowled a freebie to Mayers. Short delivery angling into leg from 'round the wicket. Mayers pulls it over deep backward square leg for a maximum. Free Hit coming up.
Kingma goes full on middle. Brooks flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Starts off with a shortish length, on off. Mayers pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Vivian Kingma is back on.
A tossed up ball, low full toss, around middle. Shamarh Brooks works it away towards mid on.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Shamarh Brooks! A shorter ball, darting it on the pads. Shamarh Brooks swivels and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary. Poor delivery from Aryan Dutt!
Another fuller ball, around off. Shamarh Brooks once again drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Loopy ball, slower through the air, full, around off. Shamarh Brooks leans and pushes it to cover.
Fuller now, tosses it up, on middle. Shamarh Brooks works it away towards mid on.
Shorter ball, outside off. Shamarh Brooks gets his bat down late and dabs it to short third man.
Another pitched up ball, around middle and leg. Shamarh Brooks flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Much fuller now, darting it on the pads. Kyle Mayers flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Shorter ball, around off. Kyle Mayers pushes it towards cover.
Tosses it up, fuller ball, around middle. Shamarh Brooks knocks it to long on for a biggie.
SIX! Bang! That will release the pressure! A fuller ball, around middle. Shamarh Brooks gets low and heaves it high over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Down the leg side, fuller ball. Shamarh Brooks looks to sweep this away but he misses and gets hit on his thigh pads.
Tad shorter, outside off. Kyle Mayers back away and cuts it towards point. A maiden over!
Once again the same thing! Outside off, fuller ball. Kyle Mayers drives it to mid off.
Tad fuller, around off. Kyle Mayers makes room and drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Outside off, on the short side. Kyle Mayers pushes it to mid off.
Drifting in, around middle, shorter ball. Kyle Mayers manages to get an inside edge towards short fine leg.
Shorter ball, around off. Kyle Mayers looks to push this away on the off side, but the ball goes off the under edge back to the bowler.
Darts this one on the pads. Brooks goes back and works it towards deep square leg for a couple.
Fuller now, outside off. Shamarh Brooks leans and drives it towards mid off.
Shortish ball, around the off pole. Shamarh Brooks once again pushes it towards cover.
Full, outside off. Shamarh Brooks blocks it towards the off side.
Fuller ball, around middle and leg. Shamarh Brooks defends it out.

A huge shout for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger! Shamarh Brooks reviews it once again. A shorter ball, angling down leg. Shamarh Brooks looks to flick but he misses and gets hit on his pads. No bat involved confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows it was sliding down leg. Once again, the decision has to be reversed.
The skipper, Pieter Seelaar comes onto bowl now.
Around middle and off, shorter ball. Shamarh Brooks pushes it off the back foot towards cover for a single.

Direct-hit! But Kyle Mayers is safe! A shorter ball, around middle and leg. Shamarh Brooks tucks it off the back foot towards deep mid-wicket. They run the first one and Kyle Mayers leaves his crease for the second run as well. The fielder collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the non-striker end. But the reply shows that Kyle Mayers has just made his ground. Close call!
SIX! And again! This is a replica of the previous six! Overpitches this one, around off. Shamarh Brooks once again smokes it over mid off for another maximum.
Shorter now, around middle. Shamarh Brooks defends it out.
SIX! Oh, shot! Much fuller now, around off. Shamarh Brooks smashes it powerfully straight down the ground for a biggie.
Quicker, flatter, and shorter, around off. Shamarh Brooks pushes it back to the bowler off the back foot.
Angling into the body, on a length. Brooks clips it towards square leg for a single.
WIDE! This is full and down the leg side again. Brooks lets it go again.
Fuller on middle. Brooks drives it straight to mid on.
Lands on a length, on middle. Brooks nudges it towards mid-wicket.
WIDE! Logan van Beek bangs it short and around leg. Brooks lets the ball go.
A fullish delivery, on off. Brooks leans forward and drives it through covers. He comes back for the second run as the fielder cuts it off.
WIDE! It is full and down the leg side. Brooks lets it go.
On a length, around off. Brooks dabs it towards point again.
Back of a length, around off. Brooks punches it towards point.
Quicker and flatter, around off. Brooks chops it to short third man for a single.

NOT OUT! Dutt bowls it a bit short and the ball is turning into middle and leg. Brooks looks to pull it but misses. The ball hits him on the pads and there is an appeal. The umpire raises his finger this time but Brooks reviews it straightaway. The Ball Tracking shows that the ball is missing stumps as it is going over them. So Brooks survive and the decision will be overturned.

Review! Shamarh Brooks reviewed an LBW decision. No bat involved confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracking confirms that it was too high and it was missing the wickets. The on-field decision needs to overturned. Shamarh Brooks survives!
Tossed up, on off. Mayers drives it to long off for a single.
Shorter length, outside off. Brooks cuts it to covers for a single.
Fuller on off. Brooks drives it to mid on.

FIFTY for Kyle Mayers! Very good innings, he was promoted up the order and he has grabbed this opportunity with both hands and would be looking to get a big one here. Coming to the ball, it is on the shorter side on off. Mayers goes back and pushes it down the ground for a single.
Dot to end the over! On a length, on off. Brooks blocks it out.
A full delivery, on off. Mayers drives it towards covers for a single.
Overpitched on off. Mayers drives it uppishly and over mid off for a couple.
Serves a length delivery, on off. Mayers blocks it out.
This is on a length and outside off. Mayers guides it towards deep backward point for a couple.
Back of a length, around off. Brooks steers it towards third man for a single.
Logan van Beek (3-1-9-0) comes back to bowl.

NOT OUT! Brilliant change of pace again by Dutt! After two deliveries that were slower in pace, Dutt pushes this one quicker and it pitches around off and comes in with the angle. Mayers looks to defend it off the front foot but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal but the umpire says no. Netherlands reviews it. The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows that the impact was the umpire's call and the original decision will stay.
Slower in the air, on middle. Mayers takes a big stride forward and works it towards it towards the leg side.
Tossed up, around off. Mayers defends it towards the off side.
Well bowled! An arm ball there that skids off the surface. Lands on off and comes in with the angle. Mayers looks to cut but mistimes it.
Flatter and angling into middle. Mayers works it towards the leg side.
On the shorter side, outside off. Brooks cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.

DRINKS! After electing to bat first, West Indies have progressed well! They might have lost Shai Hope but promoting Kyle Mayers up the order has worked in their favour. He along with Shamarh Brooks will look to build a partnership here. Netherlands will want to take things under control from here and grab quick wickets to put the visitors under pressure.

FOUR! Mayers ends the over with another boundary! Bas de Leede bangs it short angling into the body from 'round the wicket. Mayers pulls it towards the deep backward square leg region and the ball races away towards the fence.
Tad shorter again, around off. Mayers punches it through covers for a couple.
Lands on a length, on off. Mayers blocks it out.
FOUR! Good shot! On the shorter side, on off. Mayers pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
WIDE! Back of a length and angling down the leg side. Mayers looks to pull it away but misses.
A fullish length delivery and drifting on the pads again. Brooks flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, on middle. Brooks works it towards the deep square leg region for a couple.
Ta fuller, around middle and off. Kyle Mayers lunges forward and defends it out.
Shorter ball, around the leg pole. Kyle Mayers looks to flick this away but he misses and the ball hits him on his pads.
Drifting in around middle and leg. Kyle Mayers blocks it out off the back foot.

Aryan Dutt sticks with the shorter ball, around middle and off. Shamarh Brooks punches it off the back foot through cover. The ball will not race away to the boundary but the batters pick up three runs.
Another shorter ball, spinning away, around off. Kyle Mayers pushes it off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Kyle Mayers pushes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, around middle. Shamarh Brooks blocks it out towards mid-wicket.
Bas de Leede serves a length ball now, outside off. Kyle Mayers steers it down to third man for a single.
On a good length, around middle. Shamarh Brooks taps it towards mid on and scampers across to the other end for a quick single.
Angling in around middle and leg, on a fuller length. Shamarh Brooks flicks it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Bas de Leede drops it short now from over the wicket, around middle. Shamarh Brooks ducks under it. Good change of length!
A length ball from 'round the wicket, outside off. Kyle Mayers pushes it off the back foot towards deep cover for a single.
Slower through the air, full, around off. Shamarh Brooks blocks it out solidly.
Tad shorter, outside off. Shamarh Brooks dabs it towards point. No run there!
Fuller ball, outside off. Kyle Mayers leans forward and drives it through cover for a single.
Shorter now, outside off. Kyle Mayers cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Loopy ball, full again from over the wicket, around middle. Shamarh Brooks pushes it towards long on and rotates the strike. He gets off the mark with that.
Aryan Dutt begins with a tossed up delivery from 'round the wicket, very full, around middle. Kyle Mayers knocks it down to long off and takes a single.
Aryan Dutt is into the attack now.
Outside off, length delivery. Shamarh Brooks leaves it alone. End of a successful first over from Bas de Leede!
Another good-length delivery, around middle and off. Shamarh Brooks once again defends it out.
On a length, around middle. Shamarh Brooks blocks it out from within the crease.
Shamarh Brooks walks in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Bas de Leede strikes in his first over as he gets rid of Shai Hope! A much-needed wicket for Netherlands. Shai Hope was just about to get going and Netherlands have struck at the right time. Bas de Leede hits the deck hard and serves a shorter ball, outside off. Shai Hope looks to pull this but he gets a top edge. The ball lobs up high towards mid off and Vivian Kingma there takes a dolly. West Indies have lost their first wicket!
Commentary.Howout: c Vivian Kingma b Bas de Leede

Commentary.Commentary: Angling in again, around middle on a good length. Shai Hope once again tucks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Bas de Leede begins with a length ball, angling in around middle and leg. Shai Hope tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Another shortish ball, outside off. Shai Hope dabs it towards third man for a single. He retains the strike.
Back of a length, outside off. Kyle Mayers pushes it off the back foot towards point for a single.
A length ball, angling in around middle and leg. Kyle Mayers looks to block this but he gets an inside edge towards short fine leg.
FOUR! WOW! Wonderful shot! Another half-volley, outside off. Kyle Mayers drives it aerially over cover for a boundary.
Fuller ball, outside off. Shai Hope drives it towards sweeper cover. Single taken!
A good-length delivery, angling in around middle. Shai Hope blocks it out.

It is taken by Vikramjit Singh but doesn't matter as it is a Free Hit! A fullish delivery, around off. Hope looks to slog it towards the leg side. However, he completely miscues it and the ball goes behind mid off. Vikramjit Singh runs behind and takes the catch. In the meanwhile, the batters run a single. This will also be the end of Powerplay 1 and now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over in the Powerplay 2.
NO BALL! A fullish delivery on middle. Mayers works it to mid on for a single. Kingma though as overstepped again and we will have a Free Hit coming up again.
A fuller delivery on off. Mayers drives it straight but Kingma stops it with a dive on the follow through.
WIDE! Angling down the leg side this time. A length ball again and Mayers looks to clip it but misses.
On a length, on off. Mayers skips down the track and drives it to extra-cover.

SIX! Kyle Mayers with a brilliant shot off the Free Hit! Kingma tries to go for a wide yorker, misses his length and ends up being an half-volley for Mayers. He slices it over cover-point all the way for a maximum.
NO BALL! Kingma has overstepped again. Lands on a length, around off. Mayers blocks it from his crease. A Free Hit coming up now.
Serves a length delivery again, tight line, on off. Mayers defends it again.
On a length, on off. Mayers blocks it out.
FOUR! Lovely shot and this is the third boundary of the over! Klein delivers it full on middle. Hope shows the full face of his blade and drives it crisply past mid on for a boundary.
On a length, on middle. Mayers works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
A full and wider delivery outside off. Mayers tries to drive it again but misses.
FOUR! Half-volley and Mayers takes full advantage of it. It is full and around off. Mayers creams the drive through covers for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Mayers drives it towards the off side.
FOUR! Authorative shot by Mayers! On the shorter side, around off. Mayers picks the length quickly and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Another dot to end the over and just 2 runs from it! On a length, on middle. Hope glances it to square leg.
Back of a length, around off. Hope dabs it towards point.
Nice timing and equally good fielding there! On a length, on off. Hope punches it left of mid off. However, Logan van Beek moves swiftly to his left and dives to stop it.
Lands on a length, on off. Hope blocks it out.
Goes full on middle again. Hope works it right of mid on.
Overpitched on pads. Hope flicks it towards the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Lands on a length, outside off. Mayers looks to drive it away but misses.

Drifting on the pads and Hope flicks it bit aerially towards mid-wicket. The fielder there dives to his left but fails to stop it. He, however, slows the pace of the ball and the batters run three as the fielder cuts it off near the fence.
A full delivery on middle. Hope drives it firmly to mid on.
Good stop! Overpitched delivery, on off. Hope lunges forward and drives it crisply towards covers. However, Max O'Dowd there dives to his left and stops it with one hand.
Angling into middle and leg and bit full this time. Hope clips it to mid on.
Klein starts with a length delivery on off. Hope punches it to mid off.
Ryan Klein comes into the attack.
It is pushed across the batter this time. It is a length delivery again. Mayers tries to slash it away but misses.
FOUR! Beautifully played! Kingma keeps it on the shorter side and around off. Enough width for Mayers to stand tall and punch it away through covers for a boundary.
Back of a length, on off. Mayers blocks it off the back foot.
Ohh...inside edge! A fullish length, on off. Hint of shape into the batter. Hope looks to drive it away but gets the inside edge and the ball goes past the stumps towards fine leg for a single.
Lands on a length, close to off pole this time. Mayers punches it to covers for a single.
Kingma with a back-of-a-length delivery, outside off. Mayers throws his bat at it but misses.
A length delivery, outside off. Shai Hope taps it towards the fielder at point. A midfield there but no run taken! A maiden over from Logan van Beek!
Back of a length, around middle and off, at around 1226 clicks. Shai Hope stands tall and pushes it towards point.
Make that four! Another pitched up delivery, around middle. Shai Hope works it away towards the fielder at mid on.
Three dots in a row! A fuller ball, tailing back in around middle and leg. Shai Hope flicks it towards mid-wicket.
On a length, around middle. Shai Hope blocks it out off the back foot.
Lovely delivery! A yorker now, around middle. Shai Hope digs it back to the bowler.
Fuller now, around off. Shai Hope pushes it towards cover off the front foot.
FOUR! Top shot! Shorter ball, outside off. Shai Hope punches it past extra-cover for a cracking boundary.
Outside off, tad shorter. Shai Hope taps it towards point.
Good-length delivery, around off. Shai Hope stays in his crease and defends it out.
A low full toss, outside off. Shai Hope slices it straight to the fielder at cover-point. Nothing off the Free Hit!
No ball! On a good length, around the off pole. Shai Hope blocks it out. Vivian Kingma has overstepped here and a no ball is called! Free Hit to follow!

Close! A fuller ball, around middle, tailing back in. Shai Hope chips it back to the bowler. Vivian Kingma manages to get his right hand down towards the ball on his follow-through. The replay shows that the ball just brushes the ground before he grabs it. Never easy to take such return catches. Top effort though!
On a length, around middle. Kyle Mayers defends it from within his crease.
Fuller now, on the pads. Logan van Beek flicks it towards deep square leg for a brace.

An appeal for LBW, but no given! A length ball, around middle and leg, nips back in as well. Kyle Mayers looks to block this but the ball hits his front pad first, and then he manages to get an inside edge back onto his pads. That was probably pitching outside leg. Well bowled though!
Shorter ball, around off. Kyle Mayers stands tall and pushes it towards the fielder at cover.
Good-length delivery, shaping away, outside off. Kyle Mayers leaves it alone.
Back of a length, around 135 clicks, around the off pole. Kyle Mayers gets on his toes and defends it out.
Shortish ball, around middle. Shai Hope blocks it out off the back foot.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Shai Hope tucks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Much fuller now, around off. Shai Hope drives it towards cover.
On a length, around middle. Shai Hope blocks it out.

Put down! A very tough chance though! A fuller ball, wide of off. Kyle Mayers drives away from his body. The ball goes off the outer half and lobs up towards gully. Vikramjit Singh there dives to his right, and gets his hands on it but he fails to hold on to it. Single taken!

Vivian Kingma begins with a length delivery, outside off. Kyle Mayers stands tall and tries to push this away but the ball goes off the inside edge just away from the leg pole towards short fine leg. No run taken there!
Vivian Kingma to share the new ball with Logan van Beek.

FOUR! Lovely shot! A fuller ball, around middle. Shai Hope presents the full face of the bat and drives it straight down the ground for a boundary. First boundary of the innings. 7 runs off the first over!
Wide! A shorter ball, down the leg side.  Shai Hope looks to pull this away but he misses. Wide called!
This one lands on a length, tails back in, around middle. Shai Hope blocks it out.
Good-length delivery, shaping away, outside off. Shai Hope lets that go through to the keeper.
Swinging away now, outside off, length delivery. Shai Hope leaves it alone.
Beaten! Well bowled! Another length ball, nipping back in outside off. Shai Hope looks to drive this but he gets beaten on the inside edge.
Runs straightaway! Logan van Beek begins with a length ball, angling in on the pads. Shai Hope tucks it towards deep square leg for a brace. Shai Hope and West Indies are up and running!

We are all set to begin! Netherlands players are out there in the middle. Shai Hope and Kyle Mayers are the openers for West Indies. The players take knee in support of the Black Lives Matter movement. Logan van Beek to start with the ball. Here we go...

Pieter Seelaar, the skipper of Netherlands, says that whatever they do, they have to do it well. Mentions that they have competed in the last two games and it will be good to go ahead and get a win. Informs that they have one change.

Nicholas Pooran, the skipper of West Indies, says that they are going to bat first, it is a good opportunity to put a total on a really good wicket. Adds that they will back their openers to do the job for them today and hopefully things go in their way today. Informs that they have two changes, Alzarri Joseph and Anderson Phillip make way for Jayden Seales and Shermon Lewis.

Netherlands (Playing XI) - Vikramjit Singh, Max O'Dowd, Musa Ahmad, Bas de Leede, Scott Edwards (WK), Teja Nidamanuru, Pieter Seelaar (C), Logan van Beek, Aryan Dutt, Ryan Klein, Vivian Kingma (In place of Shariz Ahmad).

West Indies (Playing XI) - Shai Hope (WK), Shamarh Brooks, Nkrumah Bonner, Nicholas Pooran (C), Brandon King, Kyle Mayers, Keacy Carty, Akeal Hosein, Shermon Lewis (In place of Anderson Phillip), Jayden Seales (In place of Alzarri Joseph), Hayden Walsh.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of West Indies. They have elected to BAT first.

The Dutch have done well in patches but they have failed to seize the opportunities they have got. Their bowling unit has done reasonably well but the batters need to step up and put a healthy total on the board if they are to bat first once again. Netherlands will be aiming to win this final game and grab those vital 10 points in the ICC World Cup Super League and of course to avoid a series whitewash at home. Who will win this final battle? We will find out. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.

It was not an easy win for West Indies in the previous game. They were put on the back foot early in the game, but Brandon King ensured they get over the line. He has scored consecutive half-centuries and has been the most consistent player for his side. He will look to carry on his form in this final ODI. The bowlers have caused a lot of trouble and they will want to replicate their performance to clean sweep the series.

Hello and a warm welcome to the third and final ODI in this exciting series between Netherlands and West Indies. The visitors have taken a commanding 2-0 lead and have clinched the series, while Netherlands have fought well but have not enjoyed much success. However, they will be looking to fill the gaps and get over the line this time and end the series on a positive note.
